matching_graph.note: Upstream GraphTheory.connectivity.matching specialized to the whole edge set E(G): two edges of G sharing a vertex are equal. Proved equivalent to every vertex having at most one neighbour and to a forest of maximum degree at most one; no connectedness, nonemptiness or perfectness guard.

hg_matching.note: M is a subfamily of the hyperedge family E and its distinct members are pairwise disjoint (MathComp trivIset, hg_matchingP); arbitrary finite carrier, M before E; the empty hyperedge is allowed, no uniformity, positivity, covering or maximality guard.
